title: feat: Add getUserDefinedConfig to merge init config and directives
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary
This PR introduces a new function getUserDefinedConfig in the global config file.
- Combines configFromInitialize and all directives into a single user-defined config object.
- Added unit tests covering multiple scenarios to validate merging behavior.

linked issue #6763
